mapper.select:
select (select count(1) from shop_product p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.merchant_id = #{merchantId}) as product_total, (select count(1) from shop_product p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = 'ON_SALE' and p.merchant_id = #{merchantId}) as on_sale_count, (select count(1) from shop_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and o.merchant_id = #{merchantId}) as order_total, (select count(1) from shop_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and o.create_time >= curdate() and o.create_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day) and o.merchant_id = #{merchantId}) as today_orders, (select coalesce(sum(o.total_amount), 0) from shop_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and o.status in ('PAID', 'SHIPPED', 'RECEIVED') and o.merchant_id = #{merchantId}) as sales_amount,
(select count(distinct o.user_id) from shop_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and o.merchant_id = #{merchantId})
(select count(1) from shop_user u where u.del_flag = '0')
as user_total,
(select count(1) from shop_verification_report r inner join shop_product p on p.product_id = r.product_id where r.status = 'PUBLISHED' and p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and p.del_flag = '0')
0 as report_total
select o.status as code, count(1) as count_value from shop_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} group by o.status
select p.status as code, count(1) as count_value from shop_product p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} group by p.status

select date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date_value, count(1) as count_value from shop_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and o.create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) and o.create_time < date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day) and o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} group by date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date_value
